newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet gains as NYMEX rebounds, diffs weaken.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet gains as NYMEX rebounds, diffs weaken.

text.p: Spot jet fuel prices firmed Thursday, as the recovery in NYMEX prices offset a slight dip in differentials.

NYMEX futures jumped more than 1.00 cent by the close, helped by news of a fire at Tosco's 140,000 barrel per day fluid catalytic cracker at its Bayway, New Jersey refinery, as well as short covering following the recent sharp losses.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade jet fuel was talked between 1.50 and 1.75 cents over the NYMEX, while U.S. Gulf 54-grade barrels were done at 1.85 cents over the screen near midday, traders said.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
